title: Put discipline on the body
summary: Contentment, humility, and meditation make discipline plain and believable. Choose the practice that leaves the heart steadier, not louder.
takeaway: Choose the practice that leaves the heart steadier, not louder.
lifeApplication: Before the routine becomes performance, touch the body back into honesty. Choose the repetition that makes you smaller, steadier, and less hungry for notice.

source.shortMeaning: Contentment, humility, and meditation make discipline plain and believable.
source.lifeApplication: Before the day's first performance, choose the practice that humbles you.

evidence.coreClaim: Contentment, humility, and meditation make discipline plain and believable.
evidence.turn: Hold onto this: conquer the mind before trying to conquer the world.
